stem.en: A friend says, "The first Qin emperor built the Great Wall." What is the best reply?

text.en: That is right. The whole wall was finished in his 15 years.

feedback.en: Fifteen years is far too short. The book says the wall was built over a period of two thousand years.

text.en: That is wrong. The Qin had nothing to do with the wall.

feedback.en: This goes too far. The Qin are linked with joining earlier walls, even though they did not start them.

text.en: Only partly. Several walls were built from 680 BCE, they were later joined, and repairs went on to the 17th century CE.
Only partly. The Han built the whole wall, and the Qin only repaired it.

feedback.en: The Han extended the wall, but the first walls are much older. They date from 680 BCE onwards.

explanation.en: Many rulers worked on the wall. Separate walls came first, they were joined later, and expansion and repair lasted till the 17th century CE.

hints.en: When does the book date the first walls?
